get.description:
GET /v1/sites/{id}/tree returning nested hierarchy with height order and ETag.

Tenant and site scope come only from the token. (Previously an unauthenticated caller could
name any tenant in a header, with a hard-coded tenant as fallback.)

schema.title: Response Get Site Tree Endpoint V1 Sites  Site Id  Tree Get

post.description:
Check in to a site validating geofence distance and permit validity window.

Tenant, site scope and visitor come from the token. (Previously the tenant came from a client
header with a hard-coded fallback, no token was needed, and any caller could name any
override_by to skip the geofence.) Overriding at check-in needs field.visit.override, and the
override is recorded as the calling supervisor.

schema.title: Response Check In V1 Sites  Site Id  Visits Post

patch.description:
Check out of site, stop timer, and return warning if outbox items remain unsynced.

Only the visitor themself, or a supervisor with field.visit.override, can close a visit.

post.summary: Publish a validated version with step-up verification (API4.13)
post.description:
API4.13: Publish model version, allocate stable balloons, and emit outbox event.

Needs BOTH the field.model.publish permission AND step-up: X-Stepup-Token must be a core token
(verified against the core JWKS) for the same user and tenant, issued within the last 5 minutes,
i.e. a fresh re-authentication. (Previously any non-empty header bypassed the permission check.)

events.title: Events

ConfirmMethod.title: ConfirmMethod
ConfirmMethod.description:
How the operator confirmed (contract §4): ``touch`` = saw the review screen and pressed
"Yes, post it"; ``voice`` = an accepted ``post`` turn followed by ``confirm`` within 10 s.

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Core P10 device token, SSO session token or core app token

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Field device id (from POST /v1/devices or a previous exchange)

core_permissions.title: Core Permissions
core_permissions.description: the core token's permissions claim (M4 F7); field decides nothing on them

FlagIn.title: FlagIn
FlagIn.description:
``missing`` (any job; audit reasons not_found / removed_by_other / inaccessible), ``short``
(pick: bin_empty / damaged / not_found, FR3.020; receive: an under-delivery reason), ``damaged``
(receive: photo evidence and quantity, FR3.009), ``under`` (receive). ``reason`` is the contract
name of ``reason_code``.

code.title: Code
code.description: the scanned barcode (or a material number)

description.title: Description
description.description: what the operator says it is

qty.title: Qty
qty.description: receipt: delivery quantity; count: the count

mock_location.title: Mock Location
mock_location.description: Whether the phone reported a mock location provider

PiItemIn.title: PiItemIn
PiItemIn.description:
One bin/material to count. Without ``book_qty`` the server snapshots the field bin stock
(field.bin_stock), so the book never passes through a client; ``unit_price`` defaults to
FIELD_PI_DEFAULT_UNIT_PRICE (no price source on ErpPort yet).
